programme.title: Broad City: Two Chainz
programme.desc: Abbi og Ilana opplever store klesuhell på vei til en venns utstilling og legger ut på en desperat jakt etter et offentlig toalett.

programme.title: Broad City: Co-Op
programme.desc: Abbi må late som om hun er Ilana for å ta hennes skift på jobben, mens Ilana drar til Long Island pga en svært viktig legetime.

programme.title: Broad City: Game Over
programme.desc: Ilana får en ny mulighet på Deals, Deals, Deals, og Abbi prøver å holde konkurranseinstinktet i sjakk på Soulstice Games Day.

programme.title: Broad City: Rat Pack
programme.desc: Etter å ha mottatt en heftig regning for skadedyrsbekjempelse, holder Jaime og Ilana en fest for å dekke kostnadene. I mellomtiden drar Abbi ut på tokt for å møte nye mennesker.

programme.title: Broad City: 2016
programme.desc: Ilana finner sitt nye kall, og Abbi må innom det mest fryktede sted i verden: biltilsynet.

programme.title: Broad City: Philadelphia
programme.desc: Abbi og Ilana drar til Philly for å besøke Abbis barndomshjem . Når Abbi innser at hun gjorde en stor tabbe på videregående, drar hun og Ilana på forsoningsoppdrag.

programme.title: Broad City: B&B-NYC
programme.desc: Abbi og Ilana legger ut leilighetene sine på B & B-NYC for å tjene litt ekstra penger.

programme.title: Broad City: Burning Bridges
programme.desc: Ilanas foreldre kommer til byen for deres 30-årsjubileum, men Abbi og Ilana syns det er vanskelig å feire når de begge opplever samlivsproblemer.

programme.title: Broad City: Getting There
programme.desc: Abbi og Ilana skal ut på tur, men bare det å komme seg til flyplassen viser seg å være mye vanskeligere enn forventet.

programme.title: Broad City: Jews on a Plane
programme.desc: Abbi får mensen under en flytur, så hun og Ilana går drastisk til verks for å finne en tampong.

programme.title: Broad City: Sliding Doors
programme.desc: En vårdag i 2011 møtes Abbi og Ilana for første gang.

programme.title: Broad City: Twaining Day
programme.desc: Abbis korte tilbakekomst til Soulstice blir interessant når hun får opplæringsmuligheten som hun alltid har drømt om. I mellomtiden får Ilana en ny jobb på en restaurant.

programme.title: Broad City: Just the Tips
programme.desc: Ilana går amok med pengene hun tjente på servitørjobben, og Abbis nye forhold gjør at det lyser av henne. På fest senere den kvelden, møter jentene på en gammel venn.

programme.title: Broad City: Mushrooms
programme.desc: Abbi og Ilana ruser seg på sopp og opplever en hendelsesrik trip.

programme.title: Broad City: Abbi's Mom
programme.desc: Abbis mor kommer til byen på besøk, og Ilana navigerer Sushi Mambeaux' intense arbeidskultur samtidig som hun håndterer sin sesongavhengig depresjon.

programme.title: Broad City: Witches
programme.desc: Abbi føler seg gammel etter å ha funnet et grått hår; Ilana går til en sexterapeut.

programme.title: Broad City: Florida
programme.desc: Abbi, Ilana, Eliot og Bobbi drar til Florida for å rydde ut av Grandma Esthers leilighet.

programme.title: Broad City: House Sitting
programme.desc: Abbi, Ilana, Jaime og Lincoln passer huset til Strands. Ilana og Lincoln definerer forholdet deres, og Abbi går på en Bumble-date med en mann fra fortiden hennes.

programme.title: Broad City: Bed Bugs
programme.desc: En fancy ny veske gir Abbi tillit under arbeidsledigheten. Ilana og Jaimé må ta tak i et uunngåelig New York City-mareritt.

programme.title: Broad City: Friendiversary
programme.desc: Jentenes 'Friendiversary' utvikler seg i en farlig retning når de blir vitne til noe forferdelig.

programme.title: Broad City: Stories
programme.desc: Abbi og Ilana farer fra toppen av Manhattan til bunnen for å feire Abbis 30-årsdag, og treffer på både gamle og nye venner på veien.

programme.title: Broad City: Shework and S**t Bucket
programme.desc: Ilana gir seg i kast med sin seneste mulighet til å tjene penger da hun en åpner et utendørs kontorlandskap for New Yorks røykere; Abbi konfronterer husverten sin da han nekter å modernisere sanitæranlegget hennes.

programme.title: Broad City: Bitcoin & the Missing Girl
programme.desc: Ilana besøker en gammel flamme for å få sin del av en Bitcoin-formue; Abbi glemmer klesvasken sin for første gang, og mister favorittgenseren sin.

programme.title: Broad City: Make the Space
programme.desc: Ilana oppdager en skremmende hemmelighet om Jaimé; Abbi prøver å avansere fra genserbretter til vinduskunstner på Anthropologie.

programme.title: Broad City: Artsy Fartsy
programme.desc: Abbi inviteres til et fancy kunstarrangement på MoMA; Ilana og Lincoln analyserer det første året de har vært sammen.

programme.title: Broad City: Lost and Found
programme.desc: Jentene møter Ilanas femtenmenning, som overlevde Holocaust, og tar ham med på en kjedelig brunch; Abbi prøver en ny look.

programme.title: Broad City: Shenanigans
programme.desc: Ilana rekrutteres som hårmodell; Abbis nye flamme forteller henne at hun ikke er moden nok.

programme.title: Broad City: Sleep No More
programme.desc: Abbi og Ilana besøker 'Sleep No More', og Abbi prøver å finne rett tidspunkt for å fortelle Ilana noe som vil forandre livet hennes radikalt.

programme.title: Broad City: Along Came Molly
programme.desc: Abbi, Ilana og Bevers selger Abbis eiendeler i New York; Abbi får billetter til en Lil Wayne-konsert, og jentene tar en 'tripp'.

programme.title: Broad City: Broad City
programme.desc: Jentene tar farvel.

programme.title: Broad City: What A Wonderful World
programme.desc: Ilana får nyss om en hemmelig Lil Wayne-konsert. Sammen med Abbi loffer hun seg frem i New York. Jentene lar ingenting hindre dem i å skrape sammen nok penger til billettene. Selv om det blir skremmende, mister de aldri målet av sikte.

programme.title: Broad City: Stolen Phone
programme.desc: Etter å ha prøvd å finne gutter på Facebook, bestemmer Abbi og Ilana seg for å prøve å finne gutter i 'virkeligheten'.

programme.title: Broad City: Working Girls
programme.desc: Ilana prøver å tjene litt ekstra penger i 'temp game'. Abbi lover naboen sin å vente på pakken hans, men hun går glipp av leveransen og må dra til verdens ende for å få fatt i den.

programme.title: Broad City: The Lockout
programme.desc: Når Abbi får sprøytet leiligheten sin mot skadedyr og Ilana mister nøklene sine, blir jentene nødt til å bo på gaten - akkurat når Abbi har sin første kunstutstilling.

programme.title: Broad City: P*$$Y Weed
programme.desc: Jentene må bli voksne! Abbi vil kjøpe sin egen marihuana, som en voksen kvinne, mens Ilana må takle skatten på egen hånd. Og, jentene er høye som hus.

programme.title: Broad City: Fattest Asses
programme.desc: Når Abbi innser at hun er for snill, blir hun mere bitchy. Ilana bestemmer seg for å nå sitt fulle potential. De går på en eksklusiv fest og møter noen eventyrlige DJ-er. Nå kan ingenting gå galt.

programme.title: Broad City: Hurricane Wanda
programme.desc: Abbi og Ilana klarer sig igennem stormen med hjælp fra deres venner (Jaimé, Lincoln og Jeremy), men de får desværre selskab af Bevers og hans søster. Et spil 'Who Done It?' udspiller sig, mens orkanan raser udenfor.

programme.title: Broad City: In Heat
programme.desc: Ilana leter febrilsk etter en gave i siste øyeblikk til Lincoln, mens Abbi prøver å finne et klimaanlegg for å få det kjølig på soveværelset.

programme.desc: Robin tar en tøff beslutning om sin kjære gruvebil 6 Pack etter nok et kostbart sammenbrudd.

programme.desc: Den nye gruvesesongen er full av ubehagelige overraskelser, men en usannsynlig redning redder dagen.

programme.desc: Garon og Josh mister kontrollen over Six Pack på de gjørmete veiene.

programme.desc: Mannskapet støter på uendelige problemer når de forsøker kutte ut en del av den 60 fot lange linsen.

programme.desc: Monty’s journey sees him follow the path 33 SAS soldiers took after they were parachuted behind enemy lines to attack the enemy and create chaos to draw Nazi-fascist forces away from the front line.

programme.title: Secret War: Agent Garbo
programme.desc: Juan Pujol, MI6's WWII agent "Garbo," created a fictitious spy network in Lisbon, deceiving the Germans with crucial disinformation and influencing their strategies. After the war, MI6 protected him, and he lived in Venezuela until his death in 1988.

programme.title: Weapons That Changed the World
programme.desc: Could the mighty M2 be the greatest machine gun in history? Nicknamed “Ma Deuce”, this American machine gun has dominated battlefields for over 80 years. Host Wil Willis tests it and recreates Audie Murphy’s famous Medal of Honor moment.

programme.title: Hitler's Mega Plane
programme.desc: In January 2012, Italian divers discovered the wreck of a massive plane off the coast of Sardinia. At a depth of 65 meters (213 feet) lies a Messerschmidt “Gigant”, the biggest aircraft in WWII.

programme.title: Nazi Collaborators: Vidkun Quisling
programme.desc: Vidkun Quisling, once honored for diplomacy, turned traitor by collaborating with Nazis. His bid for power in Norway failed, relegated by Germans. Despite being named "fuehrer," his reign led to repression until his hanging post-Nazi defeat.

programme.title: Hitler Uncovering His Fatal Obsession: Barbarossa Unleashed 1941
programme.desc: E1 begins with a brief examination of the rationale of hatred projected by Hitler onto the Soviet-Slavic-Jewish world. Then it leaps forward, to see Hitler initiate an invasion of the USSR.

programme.title: Nazi Collaborators: The Good Collaborators?
programme.desc: Finland defended itself in the Winter War under Marshal Mannerheim. Finland allied with Nazi Germany against the Soviet Union in 1941. Finland later negotiated peace with the Allies and switched sides as Nazi defeat became apparent.

programme.title: Signs of Evil - The Runes of the SS
programme.desc: The symbol of the SS stands for terror and the murder of millions. Documentary about the history of a symbol that represents murder.

programme.title: Weapons That Changed the World
programme.desc: Former U.S. Army Ranger Wil Willis tests modern combat shotguns like the Benelli M4 and Mossberg 590, alongside historic models.This documentary features 3D animations and weapon tests to explore effectiveness of combat shotguns.

programme.title: Hitler and I: Reflections on Evil
programme.desc: An in-depth, behind-the-scenes exploration of the making of the miniseries "Hitler: The Rise of Evil."

programme.title: The Rise of the Nazi Party: Nazis Outfought
programme.desc: By 1944, Hitler's image as a victorious leader is crumbling. He faces a bomb plot led by Stauffenberg and Tresckow, intending to kill him and overthrow the regime. Hitler survives the bombing, triggering a brutal reprisal against conspirators.

programme.title: Secret War: The SAS Italian Job
programme.desc: In 1945, during the Italian Spring offensive, SOE agent Michael Lees and SAS officer Roy Farran led a raid on German HQs at Villa Rossi and Villa Calvi. Despite orders to cancel, Farran attacked with SAS men and partisans, killing many Germans.

programme.title: Auschwitz: The Nazis and the Final Solution: Surprising Beginnings
programme.desc: Tyske kommandører oppdager effektiviteten i å gasse fanger, og Auschwitz forvandles fra en liten bakgårdsleir for de som motarbeider den nazistiske okkupasjonen av Polen, til en storstilt utryddelsesleir for jøder.

programme.title: Auschwitz: The Nazis and the Final Solution: Orders and Initiatives
programme.desc: Höss håndterer komplikasjoner som oppstår fra det midlertidige gaskammeret og økende etterspørsel ettersom nazistene begynner å feie hele Europa for flere mennesker å ta med til Auschwitz og drepe.

programme.title: Nazi Collaborators: The Arajs Kommando
programme.desc: Viktor Arajs, a Latvian, played a significant role in the Holocaust, collaborating with the Nazis to eliminate Jews. Leading the Arajs Kommando, he orchestrated the killings of around 30,000 Jews. Arajs justified his actions as patriotic defense.

programme.title: Secret War: The Special Interrogation Group
programme.desc: The SIG consisted of German speaking Jewish volunteers from Palestine. They had a highly dangerous job: which was to pose as Germans behind enemy lines and extract intelligence and do acts of sabotage. Few had a long-life expectancy.

programme.title: FantomWorks
programme.desc: FantomWorks dull the fangs on a 1965 Shelby Cobra kit car and bring a 1964 Dodge Dart back on target.

programme.title: FantomWorks
programme.desc: Dan and the team take on the restorations of a 1965 Cadillac Deville and a 1984 Monte Carlo. The 'caddie' is so full of leaves and rat droppings that it's a health hazard. The Monte Carlo is intended as an anniversary present.

programme.title: Graveyard Carz: Disneyland of Carz
programme.desc: The world is littered with the remains of forgotten muscle cars. At Graveyard Carz, some will get a second chance in the hands of Mark Worman and the Ghouls.

programme.title: FantomWorks
programme.desc: Bob spent years working on his beloved 1969 K20 Truck, but he needs FantomWorks to solve the mysteries within. Dan’s brother-in-law John shows up with a 1962 Ferrari kit car that looks hot, but the wiring could burn it to the ground.

programme.title: Muscle Cars of Texas
programme.desc: The black 1978 Trans Am has a brand new motor and its ready to be fired up for the first time. The Malicious Intent, a 1969 Mustang is ready for the paint shop. The 1972 Corvette. Ugly to beautiful restoration is in the stripping process.

programme.title: FantomWorks
programme.desc: David is a Volkswagen fanatic who wants a 1967 Beetle that can outmatch muscle cars. Robert wants a widened 1967 Corvette supercar, but first FantomWorks have to undo the bad repairs from at least three fiberglass rending accidents.

programme.title: The Ride Life
programme.desc: Sung returns to his home town LA, the car culture capital of the world. This is where Sung feels the most pressure to be on his game. But in the car scene, Sung meets old friends, discovers new inspirations, and finds a way to face life's challenges.

programme.title: FantomWorks
programme.desc: FantomWorks finish the build of the ultimate Mustang Sleeper, a California Special powered by a Coyote Aluminator. Phil wants a 1949 Chevy Pick-up, but the truck is a disassembled jigsaw puzzle with a lot of pieces missing.

programme.title: Muscle Cars of Texas
programme.desc: Vinnie and the team are hard at work on the 1976 Trans Am. The 1972 Corvette is getting a custom paint job. The 66 Mustang needs a tune up.

programme.title: FantomWorks
programme.desc: For years, Rich and Kathy tried to get their 1951 Buick Super back on the road. It’s now up to FantomWorks to succeed where four other shops failed. Dan has to solve the mystery of Jim’s classic 1961 Corvette and determine if the car needs major surgery.

programme.title: FantomWorks
programme.desc: Steve wants to run his 1954 Oldsmobile in a thousand-mile road race. Dan faces a tight budget, a tough schedule and race rules. Jim wants Fantomworks to bring his 1977 Spitfire out of a coma; but Dan puts his foot down when safety issues are discovered.

programme.title: Jet Truck
programme.desc: The Darnell's celebrate their return home by blowing off some pent-up explosive redneck frustration while Brooke tries to keep something very special under wraps.

programme.title: FantomWorks
programme.desc: Daniel wants FantomWorks to swap out the V6 of his 1968 Mustang Convertible with the V8 from a donor car. Stacia and Eugenia need Dan’s help to transform their quirky 1962 Citroen 2CV from a ‘problem child’ to a reliable car.

programme.title: Graveyard Carz: 72 Charger SE Resurrected
programme.desc: A new season of Graveyard Carz, the show wherein abandoned and left­for­death classic Mopars are given a new lease on life.

programme.title: Graveyard Carz: A Fly in the Ointment
programme.desc: A new season of Graveyard Carz, the show wherein abandoned and left­for­death classic Mopars are given a new lease on life.

programme.title: FantomWorks
programme.desc: Chris wants the 1950 F1 Truck he remembers from high school and Dean wants the 1968 Lincoln Continental he drove with his dad.

programme.title: Jet Truck
programme.desc: As Chris and Billy psych up for the big challenge race, Billy’s mechanical issues force a hilarious change in plans.

programme.title: FantomWorks
programme.desc: Kolin asks Dan to repair his smashed up 1973 Corvette, but Dan finds major problems that existed before the accident. Jim wants Dan to build him an asphalt crushing 1970 Challenger convertible by adding a 426 Hemi with all the fixin’s.

programme.title: Jet Truck
programme.desc: Tensions mount in Cayuga as a frightening crash occurs on the drag strip moments before Chris is set to perform his incredibly dangerous first night race of the season.

programme.desc: A 1917 Overland will be FantomWorks oldest restoration, if they can solve this jigsaw puzzle of rotted wood and rusted steel. Dan buys a 1968 Camaro on the internet for his wife, Malissa, and finds out that the car is in extremely poor condition.

programme.title: FantomWorks
programme.desc: Brad wants a 1967 Mustang Coupe to be new again; so Dan has to fight the way the car was initially built by the factory. Jay wants a stunning 1965 TR4, but he plans to do most of the work himself. Instead, the Fantomworks side of the job keeps growing.

programme.desc: Allison drømmer om at hun er en kvinne som er innlagt på en mentalinstitusjon i 1959. Allison oppdager så at kvinnen fra drømmen hennes påsto å være Allison DuBois, som levde i 2005.

programme.title: Medium
programme.desc: Allisons nye vane med å gå i søvne setter henne stadig i farlige situasjoner. Det gjør henne utslitt, men hun presser seg selv for å løse en kidnappingssak før det er for sent.

programme.title: Medium
programme.desc: Allison drømmer om en gammel ungdomsskolevenninne og bestemmer seg for å finne henne. I mellomtiden søker en mann distriktsadvokatens hjelp til å finne datteren sin som har vært savnet i en uke.

programme.title: Medium
programme.desc: Allison hjelper distriktsadvokaten med å fange en morder hvis advokat også bruker en synsk, samtidig som han prøver å forhindre skyting på påtalemyndighetens kontor.

programme.title: Medium
programme.desc: Joe sitter i juryen i en sak mot en mann anklaget for å ha myrdet sin rike kone. Allison begynner å få syner om mannen, men statsadvokat Devalos beordrer henne til å ikke jobbe med saken.

programme.title: Medium
programme.desc: Allison har en visjon som kan sette Devalos' sjanser for gjenvalg i fare. I mellomtiden møter Joe en ekskjæreste fra college.

programme.title: Medium
programme.desc: Allison drømmer om å kjøre på en jente med bilen sin og om en kvinne med et hjemsøkt hus. Hun finner ut at kvinnen har dødd av selvmord.

programme.title: Medium
programme.desc: Allison kan ikke få en psykotisk morder ut av hodet sitt, noe som får Joe til å bekymre seg for døtrenes velvære.

programme.title: Medium
programme.desc: Doktorens ånd fra episoden "Penny for your Thoughts" er tilbake og er ute etter Allisons datter Ariel.

programme.title: Medium
programme.desc: Allison hjelper til med å finne et savnet barn. Etterpå har hun en visjon om barnets fremtid og er ikke lenger sikker på hva hun skal gjøre for å hjelpe barnet.

programme.title: Medium
programme.desc: Allison drømmer at broren hennes var involvert i et lokalt bankran. Mistankene hennes vokser når han uventet dukker opp i byen og blir involvert med en svindler.

programme.title: Medium
programme.desc: Allison etterforsker tilsynelatende tilfeldige drap, og setter familien hennes i fare. Bridgette må holde en presentasjon om morens jobb for klassen.

programme.title: Medium
programme.desc: Tre jenter blir funnet drept. Allisons syner kobler etterforsker Scanlon til saken.

programme.title: Medium
programme.desc: Allison drømmer gjentatte ganger om en kvinne som blir overvåket av en fremmed mann på soverommet hennes.

programme.title: Medium
programme.desc: Allison er opptatt med å etterforske dødsfallet til en lokal lege når en mann som hevder å være "Døden" begynner å dukke opp i synene hennes, noe som får henne til å frykte at hun snart skal dø.

programme.title: Dynasty: The Search
programme.desc: Alexis og Blake fortsetter letingen etter Steven i Indonesia, men finner bevis for at Steven kan være død. Blake nekter å tro det og hyrer en synsk person, Jason Denner, for å få hjelp.

programme.title: Dynasty: Samantha
programme.desc: Blake fortsetter sin febrilske leting etter Steven i Denver ved hjelp av synske Jason Denner. Blake nekter å tro at sønnen er død, og Krystle er bekymret over den ustabile oppførselen hans.

programme.title: Dynasty: Danny
programme.desc: En åpenbart syk Jeff er forvirret. Sammy Jo kunngjør at hun skal til New York for å gjøre det stort som modell, og at hun ikke lenger vil beholde sønnen, Danny.

programme.title: Dynasty: Madness
programme.desc: Jeffs humør blir stadig mer ustabilt. Adam prøver å trekke Jeff inn i skandalen med Cecil Colby/Logan Rhinewood.

programme.title: Dynasty: Two Flights To Haiti
programme.desc: Selv om Blake ber henne om å vente med å gjøre noe før Jeffs voldelige oppførsel kan forklares, flyr Fallon til Haiti for å skille seg. Mark dukker uventet opp på hotellet hennes.

programme.title: Dynasty: The Mirror
programme.desc: Alexis er bekymret for at legene skal finne ut sannheten om Jeffs sykdom, men Adam prøver å dekke over ved å få kontoret pusset opp og fjerne den livsfarlige malingen.

programme.title: Dynasty: Battle Lines
programme.desc: Krystle mistenker at Alexis vet årsaken til Jeffs sykdom. Blake prøver å forhindre Alexis' foreslåtte sammenslåing. Jeff blir utskrevet fra sykehuset, og Kirby avslører sine følelser for ham.

programme.title: Reunion in Singapore
programme.desc: Blake reiser til Singapore for å identifisere sønnen, og Alexis dukker opp på flyplassen for å forsikre ham om at hun ikke vil la seg stanse i å fusjonere selskapene deres.

programme.title: Dynasty: Fathers and Sons
programme.desc: Blake overtaler Steven til å returnere til Denver for sønnens skyld. Nyheten om at Steven lever og kommer hjem setter følelsene i sving hos Carrington-familien.

programme.title: Dynasty: The Downstairs Bride
programme.desc: Da han får høre at Kirby har giftet seg med Jeff, forteller Joseph datteren at hun har ødelagt livet sitt. Blake foreslår at han og Alexis skal inngå våpenvile i kampen om Steven.

programme.title: Dynasty: The Vote
programme.desc: Da styret samles for å stemme over fusjonen mellom Denver-Carrington og Colbyco, kunngjør Alexis at de som stemmer nei får sparken omgående.

programme.title: Dynasty: The Dinner
programme.desc: Blake konfronterer Alexis med bevis på falske tall som ble brukt i den nylige fusjonen. Alexis finner ut at Blakes lukrative oljeutvinningsprosess ikke omfatter Colbyco.

programme.title: Dynasty: The Threat
programme.desc: En skandaløs avisoverskrift kobler kongressmedlemmet McVane til en ung jente i Washington. Han innser at Alexis står bak. Kirby finner ut at hun er gravid.

programme.title: Dynasty: The Cabin
programme.desc: Når Blake får vite at Stevens advokat, Chris, har flyttet sammen med sønnen, sverger han på kjempe for omsorgen for lille Danny.

programme.title: Dynasty: The Arrest
programme.desc: Krystle og Alexis, som er innesperret en brennende hytte langt uti skogen, finner ut at døren er låst – fra utsiden. Mark redder de to kvinnene på dramatisk vis.

programme.title: Dynasty: The Bungalow
programme.desc: Mark blir siktet for drap og brannstiftelse. Alexis forteller Blake og politiet at han ville hevne seg. De andre mistenkte i saken, McVane, Hess og Adam, blir avhørt og løslatt.

programme.title: Dynasty: The Note
programme.desc: Alexis får en beskjed fra avdøde Joseph – han startet brannen for å drepe henne. Claudia slipper ut fra sanatoriet. Steven og Blake slåss om lille Danny.

programme.title: Dynasty: The Hearing - Part 1
programme.desc: Kirby angriper Alexis og krever å vite hvorfor Joseph ville drepe henne. I rettsaken om foreldreretten til Danny, vitner Alexis mot Blake, som blir rasende.

programme.title: The 4400
programme.desc: While in one of Alana's fantasies, Tom and Alana see Maia, though they have no memory of her existence. Diana's life is threatened, and Tom brokers a deal with the future to set history straight.

programme.title: The 4400
programme.desc: Isabelle seeks revenge on the Nova Group after they attack Shawn. Alana confronts the man responsible for killing her husband and son in a car accident nine years ago.

programme.title: The 4400
programme.desc: With Dennis Ryland's help, NTAC tracks down the remaining members of the Nova Group. Nikki pays Shawn an unexpected visit.

programme.title: The 4400
programme.desc: Tom and Diana are drugged with a hallucinogen, which was created from an oil secreted from the hands of a 4400.

programme.title: The 4400
programme.desc: Kevin Burkhoff becomes a marked man when his research on promicin is discovered. Tom and Diana search for Kevin, but discover how far he will go to protect his work. Shawn meets his idol at the 4400 Center.
programme.sub-title: The Ballad Of Kevin And Tess

programme.title: The 4400
programme.desc: Tom and Diana's investigation into a series of gruesome murders leads them to uncover another conspiracy within the government. At the 4400 Center, Shawn receives a gift from another returnee that allows him to see his future.

programme.title: The 4400
programme.desc: NTAC and the 4400 Center work together to find Jordan Collier. Kyle Baldwin gets a surprising visitor at the state prison.

programme.title: The 4400
programme.desc: Nova Group members that were in the custody of NTAC escape from jail with outside help from Jordan Collier. Diana tells April about her relationship with Ben. Shawn and Richard learn that Isabelle is working with Dennis Ryland.

programme.title: The 4400
programme.desc: Tom and Diana continue their investigation on Jordan Collier's plan for mankind. Dennis Ryland returns to NTAC. Isabelle is seriously injured when she takes a classroom hostage.

programme.title: The 4400
programme.desc: A high school student develops an ability after injecting promicin. Tom visits Isabelle in jail, while Diana searches for her missing sister. Following the advice of a young woman named Cassie, Kyle is able to wake Shawn from his coma.

programme.title: The 4400
programme.desc: Tom and Diana search for a person who has the ability to make people's worst fears come to life. Danny seeks Shawn's help in finding a promicin shot. Cassie leads Kyle to a book that contains a prophecy about Jordan Collier.

programme.title: The 4400
programme.desc: Audrey Parker develops the ability to astral project herself. However, after she is murdered, Audrey attempts to use her ability to lead Tom and Diana to her killer.

programme.title: The 4400
programme.desc: April's new ability endangers her life. Shawn is approached to run for public office, while Kyle helps Isabelle.
programme.sub-title: The Truth And Nothing But The Truth

programme.title: The 4400
programme.desc: After realizing Tom knows he is promicin-positive, Kyle joins Jordan in a remote town called Evanston. Tom follows Kyle, and learns the remarkable truth about Evanston: all of its residents are promicin-positive.

programme.title: The 4400
programme.desc: Tom and Diana search for Curtis Peck, a 4400 film maker whose ability allows him to `know` the truth behind historical conspiracies. Jordan tries to recruit Shawn into his movement.

programme.title: The 4400
programme.desc: Jordan and his followers annex a run-down part of Seattle, dubbing it `Promise City`. Shawn's campaign for city council is threatened when a woman accuses him of using his healing ability in exchange for sex.

programme.title: The 4400
programme.desc: A lockdown at NTAC threatens the lives of Tom, Diana, Meghan, Shawn, Kyle, Jordan, Isabelle, Maia, Marco, PJ and Brady when they wakeup inside the building with no recollection of how they got there.

programme.title: The 4400
programme.desc: Richard kidnaps Isabelle from Collier's Promise City. Richard hopes to start a new life with his daughter. Elsewhere, Tess has taken over a 1950's diner, and Shawn is asked to intervene.

programme.title: The 4400
programme.desc: The Director of National Intelligence pressures NTAC to pursue Richard and Isabelle. Richard is visited by his dead wife, Lily.

programme.title: The 4400
programme.desc: A computer virus attacks a large software company owned by a suspected member of The Marked. Maia visits Promise City and receives an unexpected birthday gift.

programme.desc: Ranger Freddie Gonzalez must team up with an old enemy to bring down a demon hell-bent on enslaving culebras. Meanwhile, Seth and Richie track down an ancient hunter.

programme.title: From Dusk Till Dawn: The Series
programme.desc: When Amaru puts Scott Fuller in her sights, the Geckos and their team must defend him against Brasa's most lethal fighters yet - Jaguar Warriors from hell.

programme.title: From Dusk Till Dawn: The Series
programme.desc: A cannibal attack in a suburban neighborhood forces Seth to bring his makeshift team together to save innocent civilians.

programme.title: From Dusk Till Dawn: The Series
programme.desc: Santanico returns with a new secret - and a potential new ally - leading the Geckos to Lord Venganza, who is hiding out in a bloody culebra prison.

programme.title: From Dusk Till Dawn: The Series
programme.desc: The Geckos pursue Amaru to a mysterious Western town, where she plans to reclaim her true form and open the gates of hell.

programme.title: The Millers: The Mother Is In
programme.desc: When Carol finds out that Nathan is seeing a therapist, she secretly makes an appointment for herself in order to find out what's going on.

programme.title: The Millers: Giving The Bird
programme.desc: It's Halloween, and Nathan, Debbie, and Adam take Mikayla trick-or-treating to the house of an old woman who everyone in the neighborhood thinks is a witch.

programme.title: The Millers: Driving Miss Crazy
programme.desc: When Nathan gets frustrated after he's forced to drive Carol around town for errands once again, he demands that she either learn how to drive or find another chauffeur.

programme.title: The Millers: Internet Dating
programme.desc: When Nathan helps Carol set up her profile on an Internet dating site, he and Ray get so excited about one of her potential suitors, they start corresponding with him, pretending to be Carol.

programme.title: The Millers: You're In Trouble
programme.desc: When Nathan learns why Debbie is Tom's favorite child instead of him, he decides it's time to fill his parents in on some of Debbie's childhood secrets.

programme.title: The Millers: The Talk
programme.desc: When Carol finds out that Tom never had "the talk" with Nathan about the birds and the bees, she insists it's not too late to gather the family together and do it now.

programme.title: The Millers: Carol's Parents Are Coming to Town
programme.desc: When Carol's overbearing mother and father announce they're coming to visit for Christmas, Carol recruits Nate and Tom to cover up their failed relationships and present a happy facade.
programme.sub-title: Carol's Parents Are Coming to Town

programme.title: The Millers: Dear Diary
programme.desc: When Debbie suspects Nathan and Carol of secretly reading her diary, she and Adam plant a fake entry about Tom in order to prove it. Ernie Hudson guest stars.

programme.title: The Millers: Miller's Mind
programme.desc: Nathan learns to appreciate Carol's incessant rants after he mimics one of them at work and is rewarded with his own news segment to complain on the air.

programme.title: The Millers: Carol's Surprise
programme.desc: Nathan is determined to finally, just once, surprise the "unsurpriseable" Carol on her birthday. Brandon Routh guest stars.

programme.title: The Millers: You Betcha
programme.desc: Nathan asks Tom to spend the weekend with him in the hopes of finding something they have in common.

programme.title: The Millers: Bahama Mama
programme.desc: Just as Nathan begins to unwind on his vacation in the Bahamas, Carol's surprise appearance gets him riled up all over again until they meet Ganja Pete.

programme.title: The Millers: Tomlandia
programme.desc: When Nathan pitches a children's show to his boss, Ed Dolan, based on Tom's imaginary comic book, Tom has an adverse reaction to the tweaks made to his cherished world. Jeffrey Tambor guest stars.

programme.title: The Millers: Plus One
programme.desc: Nathan's excitement at scoring a ticket for himself and a guest to a dinner with President Obama turns to dread when he has to pick one of his family members to be his "plus one."

programme.title: The Millers: Walk-n-Wave
programme.desc: Worried that his mother has made him feel like he's better than other people, Nathan befriends a hopeless co-worker, Doug, who turns out to be a social outcast and more than Nathan knows how to handle.

programme.title: The Millers: Cancellation Fee
programme.desc: Nathan tries to date his mother's dentist in secret after Carol adds her to the Miller Family Blacklist for charging her a $75 cancellation fee for being late to her appointment.

programme.title: The Millers: 72
programme.desc: When Tom proudly tells the family he's dating a much younger woman, Nathan goes undercover to spy on him and make sure his father isn't being scammed by a gold digger.

programme.title: The Millers: Sex Ed Dolan
programme.desc: Nathan introduces his boss, Ed Dolan, to Tom in hopes they'll hit it off and hang out together, but surprisingly, Dolan only has eyes for Carol. Jeffrey Tambor guest stars.

programme.title: The Millers: Mother's Day
programme.desc: Carol has the worst Mother's Day ever when Nathan forgets to get her a present.

programme.title: The Millers: Movin' Out (Carol's Song)
programme.desc: Carol begins her search for a new apartment, causing Nathan and Debbie to race each other to find her a place that is the farthest away from each of them.

programme.title: The Millers: CON-Troversy
programme.desc: Nathan is assigned to cover a Sci-Fi Fest for his workplace and runs into a famous book author who has hated him since grade school.

programme.title: The Millers: Reunited and It Feels So Bad
programme.desc: Tom and Carol decide to formally end their marriage but are surprised when they both hesitate to finalize the divorce, sending Nathan and Debbie into a panic at the thought of their parents reconciling.
programme.sub-title: Reunited and It Feels So Bad

programme.title: The Millers: Give Metta World Peace a Chance
programme.desc: Nathan lands the biggest interview of his career with professional basketball player Metta World Peace, but when karma catches up with him, he risks ruining his professional reputation.
programme.sub-title: Give Metta World Peace a Chance

programme.title: The Millers: Diggin' Up Bones
programme.desc: In an attempt to get Carol to be more daring, Kip encourages her to confront her old Central Elementary School work nemesis, Miss Pam (Molly Shannon), at the teacher's retirement party.

programme.title: The Millers: You Are the Wind Beneath My Wings, Man
programme.desc: When Ray points out that Nathan has a history of being the worst wingman ever, Nathan embarks on a mission to be a better friend by becoming less self-involved.
programme.sub-title: You Are the Wind Beneath My Wings, Man

programme.title: The Millers: When The Pope Comes Marching In
programme.desc: When the Pope is scheduled to come to town, Nathan's planned week-long series of reports hits a snag when Ray gets a job offer to become the cameraman for a rival field reporter.
programme.sub-title: When The Pope Comes Marching In

programme.title: The Millers: Papa Was a Rolling Bone
programme.desc: The Millers decide to spend Thanksgiving apart for the first time ever, but they rethink the new family tradition when all their individual Turkey Day plans hit unexpected snags.

programme.title: The Millers: Louise Louise
programme.desc: When The Millers get a visit from their elderly Aunt Louise (Cloris Leachman), they rally to help her figure out what her legacy will be when she worries that she hasn't left her mark on the world yet.

programme.title: The Millers: Highway to the Manger Zone
programme.desc: When staging their church's annual living nativity scene does not go as planned, Kip urges the Millers to stage their own rival show.

programme.title: The Millers: Hero
programme.desc: When Nathan decides he should have a better relationship with his niece Mikayla, he agrees to use his celebrity status to help Debbie and Adam get her into a popular school.

programme.title: The Millers: Pilot
programme.desc: Nathan and his sister, Debbie, are upset when their parents announce they're divorcing after 43 years of marriage.

programme.title: The Millers: Stuff
programme.desc: Nathan hatches a plan to get his parents back together by showing them all of their sentimental family possessions in the hopes it will make them remember the good times they've had.

programme.title: The Millers: The Phone Upgrade
programme.desc: Nathan and Debbie trade parents when they each think the other sibling has it easier.

programme.title: The Millers: Plot Twists
programme.desc: When Carol dictates that it's time to rearrange the family's positions in the Millers cemetery plot because of the two divorces.

programme.desc: Rhade leder rebellerna i strid mot en krigsherre på Seefra-5.

programme.desc: Beka och Rhade hittar ett prov som antingen kommer att ge dem stora rikedomar eller driva dem till vansinne.

programme.desc: Harper upptäcker ett program som kan förstöra åtta av Seefras planeter och döda miljontals människor.

programme.desc: Medan Harper arbetar på ett sätt att rädda Seefra-systemet smyger en spion ombord på Andromeda och attackerar Beka.

programme.sub-title: Att rädda ljuset från en svart sol

programme.title: Andromeda: Total återkallelse
programme.desc: När Dylan skadas svårt i en explosion i ett labb reser han genom en rad alternativa verkligheter.

programme.title: Andromeda: Kvant-traktat delirium
programme.desc: Rommie byggs om för att hjälpa till att evakuera Seefra-systemet.

programme.title: Andromeda: En dag till i ljuset
programme.desc: En krigsherre övertygar sina anhängare om att den annalkande förstörelsen av de yttre planeterna är en komplott för att göra det lättare att plundra deras planet.

programme.title: Andromeda: Kaos och dess stillhet
programme.desc: Dylan, Rhade och Beka arbetar tillsammans för att rädda Trance från Methus-2 och Harper från general Burma.

programme.title: Andromeda: Resans hjärta (del 1)

programme.title: Andromeda: Resans hjärta (del 2)
programme.desc: Den sista striden för att rädda Nya Systems Samväldet börjar.

programme.title: Andromeda: Under natten
programme.desc: Efter att ha blivit strandsatt nära ett svart hål blir kapten Dylan Hunt upptäckt av ett bärgningsfartyg och upptäcker att han har varit frusen i tiden i 300 år.

programme.title: Andromeda: En bekräftande flamma
programme.desc: Dylan skyddar Andromeda från legosoldater medan Beka börjar undra om de kämpar för fel sida.

programme.title: Andromeda: Att förlora den avgörande blixten
programme.desc: Dylan hittar en rymdstation full av barn som tror att han är där för att skapa fred genom att döda sina fiender.

programme.title: Familjen Thunderman: Thundersinne
programme.desc: Phoebe får förmågan att ana fara innan den har hänt, och använder sitt nyfunna sinne för att imponera på sina klasskamrater. Under tiden låtsas Max att han inte har fått sitt sinne ännu för att få presenter av Barb.

programme.title: Familjen Thunderman: Ha en Cool Födelsedag
programme.desc: Phoebe och Max vill få lov att hålla ett födelsedagsparty som normala tonåringar, men när en nedfryst fru Wong kommer bort och dom måste hitta henne, inser de hur bra deras familjepartyn faktiskt är.

programme.title: Familjen Thunderman: Upp, upp och semester!
programme.desc: Familjen Thunderman deltar i en familjetävling för att vinna en drömsemester, men de har olika idéer om vart de ska åka. När de inte kan enas deltar de som två skilda lag, killar mot tjejer, och så får vinnaren bestämma.

programme.title: Familjen Thunderman: Inget är som ett pyjamasparty
programme.desc: Phoebe håller sitt första pyjamasparty och använder psykokinesi för att rädda det från att bli en katastrof. Som bestraffning måste hon ha på sig ett ankelband som hindrar henne från att använda sina krafter, så hon ber Max om hjälp.

programme.title: Familjen Thunderman: Små Vita Körer
programme.desc: När en elak tjej vid namn Veronica saboterar för Phoebe i kören och utnyttjar Max genom att få honom att göra hennes läxor, samarbetar tvillingarna för att ta hämnd på henne.

programme.title: Familjen Thunderman: Kalla Doktorerna Thunderman
programme.desc: Max och Phoebe passar Billy och får ta honom till sjukhus när han skadar tummen. Efter att Max sett en nål och svimmat, måste de allihop se till att doktorerna inte ser röntgenbilderna av hans hjärna, för då kan hans superkrafter avslöjas.

programme.title: Familjen Thunderman: Kemi är Magi
programme.desc: Hank blir Max och Phoebes nya kemilärare. När han av en olyckshändelse äter kalkonmackor som får honom att somna så måste tvillingarna använda sina krafter för att hjälpa honom genomföra en presentation och behålla sitt jobb.

programme.title: Familjen Thunderman: Fyra Superhjältar och en Bebis
programme.desc: Phoebe släpar med Billy och Nora till parken för att träffa killen hon är kär i och hans lilla lillebror, men när Max kommer för att hämta sina syskon tar han av misstag den riktiga bebisen i stället för Noras docka.

programme.title: Familjen Thunderman: Fult Spel i Hejaklacken
programme.desc: Phoebe och Cherrys vänskap sätts på prov när bara en av dem blir uttagen till cheerleader-laget. Max vinner en tävling där priset är en månads gratis pizza, och måste övertyga sin familj att han inte fuskade.

programme.title: Familjen Thunderman: Thunder-Van
programme.desc: Hank tar hem familjens Thunder-Van från Metroburg för att Phoebe ska kunna fortsätta sin superhjälteträning. När alla fyra barnen smyger sig in i bilen för att utan lov ta en tur ger Hank dem en åktur de aldrig kommer att glömma.

programme.title: Familjen Thunderman: Konsten att Sälja Konst
programme.desc: Phoebe får hjälp av Billy med ett konstprojekt, men får veta att han stulit föremålet från ett museum. Nu måste de samarbeta med Max för att ta sig in och lämna tillbaka det innan någon märker det.

programme.title: Familjen Thunderman: Max hejdukar
programme.desc: Max låter några yngre elever bli hans hejdukar, men när de vänder på situationen och gör honom till offer för ett förödmjukande skämt, måste han tänka ut ett sätt att återta positionen som skolans värsting.

programme.title: Familjen Thunderman: Jobbiga Föräldrar
programme.desc: Phoebe och Max är irriterade över familjens regler och använder en av Max apparater för att få Hank och Barb att bete sig som tonåringar. Men att då få ta över ansvaret som föräldrar får tonåringarna att ångra sig.

programme.title: Familjen Thunderman: Strimligt
programme.desc: Phoebe blir förkrossad när hon tror att familjens nya dokumentförstörare av misstag förstört hennes konsertbiljetter till MKTO. I själva verket har Max tagit dem för att bjuda sin nya kärlek på konserten. Gästartister: Sidney Park och MKTO.

programme.title: Familjen Thunderman: Phoebe Rockar
programme.desc: Phoebe försöker bli en tuff tjej för att imponera på Max nya bästa vän, en tuff rocker och frontfigur i Max nya band. Gästartist: Lizzie Green.

programme.title: Familjen Thunderman: En Dag i Gallerian
programme.desc: Phoebe och Max förvandlar en enkel tur till gallerian för att hämta Hanks födelsedagspresent till slagsmål, kaos och en kontrovers med vakten som hotar att förstöra deras pappas födelsedag.

programme.title: Familjen Thunderman: Det Stora Fiaskot
programme.desc: Max vill försöka vinna en tävling för mest misslyckade video med en 'misslyckad' video med Phoebe när hon övar balett. När Phoebe får veta hans plan vägrar hon att samarbeta och Max tar till desperata åtgärder för att få de bilder han vill ha.

programme.title: Familjen Thunderman: Vänner För Alltid
programme.desc: Phoebe och Max oroar sig för att de ska behöva umgås för jämnan när deras vänner börjar hänga med varandra. Syskonen tar till fula knep för att se till att det blir pinsamt för alla när de går på bio.

programme.title: Familjen Thunderman: De Hemsökta Thundermans Del 1
programme.desc: När en superskurk rymmer från Spökvärlden på Halloween, beger sig Thundermans till New Orleans för att tillsammans med Hathaways och Prestons besegra demonen.

programme.title: Familjen Thunderman: Mammas Superfan
programme.desc: Max och Phebe säljer av misstag några av Barbs gamla superhjältesaker till en superfan till Electress på familjens loppis, och måste skaffa tillbaka dem innan hon upptäcker det.

programme.title: Familjen Thunderman: Råtta på Rymmen
programme.desc: Max förvandlar Billy till världens snabbaste råtta för att vinna råttävlingarna han har med killarna i bandet. Billy som fått smak på att springa med superfart bestämmer sig för att han inte vill bli människa igen.

programme.title: Familjen Thunderman: Ett vintrigt Thunderland
programme.desc: Max är som den värsta Scrooge strax innan jul, tills de förflutna, nuvarande och kommande jularnas andar dyker upp för att få honom i julstämning.

programme.title: Familjen Thunderman: Evilmans
programme.desc: Det artar sig till en Romeo & Julia i supertappning när en pensionerad superskurk som råkar vara Thunder Mans gamla ärkefiende flyttar till Hiddenville, och hans son och Phoebe börjar träffa varandra i smyg.

programme.title: Familjen Thunderman: Den Blåa Detektiven
programme.desc: När Max hud blir blå under en dejt blir alla misstänkta när han agerar superdetektiv för att finna den skyldiga.

programme.title: Familjen Thunderman: En Hjälte Föds Del 1
programme.desc: Phoebe och Cherrys vänskap sätts på prov när Thundermans får oväntade nyheter och måste förbereda sig för överraskningen. Max följer med Dr. Colosso som ska ta emot priset för årtiondets skurk. Gäststjärnor: Dana Snyder, Paul F. Tompkins.

programme.title: Familjen Thunderman: En Hjälte Föds Del 2
programme.desc: Phoebe och Cherrys vänskap sätts på prov när Thundermans får oväntade nyheter och måste förbereda sig för överraskningen. Max följer med Dr. Colosso som ska ta emot priset för årtiondets skurk. Gäststjärnor: Dana Snyder, Paul F. Tompkins

programme.title: Familjen Thunderman: Dubbeltrubbel
programme.desc: Phoeve anmäler sig till en tennisturnering för att vinna ett medlemskap i Links familjs klubb. Hon övertalar Max att använda sina krafter för att hjälpa henne, men när han får smak på klubblivet går hennes plan om intet.

programme.title: Familjen Thunderman: Link Och Mörkrets Krafter
programme.desc: Max och Link bråkar varje gång Link kommer över, så Phoebe tänker ut en plan för att få dem att bli vänner. När Link börjar tillbringa mer tid med Max än med henne blir hon orolig att hennes plan har fungerat för bra.

programme.title: Familjen Thunderman: Den Ofrivilliga Hjälten
programme.desc: Phoebe försöker komma i gång med superhjälte-träningen, men när hon smyger ut på en fest och räddar en människas liv, ber hon Max att ta åt sig äran, och plötsligt blir han en hjälte.

programme.title: Familjen Thunderman: En Match med Rektorn
programme.desc: Phoebe upptäcker att Max är den anonyma figuren som ligger bakom det senaste upproriska påhitteti skolan, men närhon vägrar att avslöja hans hemlighet för rektorn får hon ta konsekvenserna.

programme.title: Familjen Thunderman: Att Hitta en Hit
programme.desc: När Max använder personliga uppgifter om Phoebe och Link i en sångtext för sitt band, orsakar han en brytning mellan dem. Samtidigt försöker Hank och Barb lära Billy och Nora en värdefull läxa.

programme.title: Familjen Thunderman: Killen Som Älskar Grupparbete
programme.desc: Phoebe går med i den coola gruppen i ett skolarbete, men upptäcker att de inte vill jobba lika hårt som hon. Max tar Phoebes vanliga plats i hennes vänners grupp för att försöka åka snålskjuts medan de andra gör allt arbete.

programme.title: Familjen Thunderman: Superbarnvakterna
programme.desc: Phoebe och Max verkar vara två vanliga tonårstvillingar, men de tillhör en familj superhjältar. Phoebe strävar efter att vara normal och använder sina krafter för att göra gott, men Max väljer den mörka sidan. Kan livet bli normalt för familjen?

programme.title: Familjen Thunderman: Middagsbjudning
programme.desc: Max planerar att sabotera middagen när Phoebe bjuder hem killen hon är kär i och hans familj för att imponera på dem, men när en oväntad gäst dyker upp måste Phoebe och Max samarbeta för att förhindra att kvällen förvandlas till en katastrof.

programme.title: Familjen Thunderman: Betyg
programme.desc: Efter att ha ändrat sina betyg och flyttats upp till avancerad matte, får Max tävla mot Phoebe i 'Matteduellen'. Samtidigt försöker Hank, Nora och Billy att fånga den gäckande tidningstjuven.

programme.title: Familjen Thunderman: Phoebe mot Max
programme.desc: När Max utsätter Phoebe för ett practical joke när de ska ta skolfoton utbryter ett practical joke-krig mellan dem som går överstyr. Samtidigt försöker sig Hank och Barb på en ny uppfostringsmodell för att få Billy och Nora att hjälpa till hemma.

programme.title: Familjen Thunderman: Knäpp Teknikmässa
programme.desc: Phoebe och Max låter sin gamla rivalitet blossa upp när de hjälper Billy och Nora med deras projekt för skolan teknikmässa. Under tiden försöker Barb ta Hank på bar gärning efter att han har kopierat hennes anteckningar för bokklubben.

programme.title: Familjen Thunderman: Helggästen
programme.desc: Phoebe har anmält sig som frivillig för att ta hand om klassens Flugfälla över helgen, men när Max utför experiment på den, börjar den växa och hotar till slut att ta över hela huset.

programme.title: Familjen Thunderman: Skolkdagen
programme.desc: Max och Phoebe använder sina krafter för att roa sig under Skolkdagen, men när de kommer på att det finns övervakningskameror på skolan tar de hjälp av Billy och Nora för att radera filmerna innan hemligheten avslöjas.

programme.title: Just for Laughs GAGS
programme.desc: Dolda kameran med riktiga människor, livs levande actionkomedi! Njut av galenskapen från världens längst pågående och mest älskade skämtshow, där intet ont anande människor hamnar i lustiga situationer.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Muddy Waters
programme.desc: A Colorado hunter is the victim of a well-planned crime. Investigators suspect two weapons and two killers. But forensic evidence points them in a different direction — one much closer to home.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Point of Origin
programme.desc: In 1984, California firefighters battled ten arson fires in three weeks. When cigarettes and a scrap of paper connected the case to similar fires further north, the hunt was on for a dangerous pyromaniac.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Seeds for Doubt
programme.desc: In 2002, a small community in upstate New York was devastated when Patty Wlasiuk died in a truck accident. But burdock seed pods found in her hair and on her clothes indicated that this was no accident — it was cold-blooded murder.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Saving Face
programme.desc: When a woman disappeared without a trace, there were two possible explanations: kidnapping or murder. Careful investigation, a forensic artist and DNA profiling enabled police to find a single suspect, who was known to prey upon vulnerable women.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Northern Exposure
programme.desc: Alaskan hikers discover a body wrapped in sheets which were edged in orange stitching. Investigators find a tuft of red carpet fibers clinging to the sheet — threads of evidence which lead them straight to the killer.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Silk Stalkings
programme.desc: Prompted by news of a flight attendant's brutal murder, the son of a previous victim contacts police. Both murders have similar MOs, and biological evidence proves that these were serial killings.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Fishing for the Truth
programme.desc: A two-man shrimp boat sinks when a fast-moving, violent storm strikes the Louisiana coast. The captain drowns, but the deckhand is rescued fourteen hours later. The crewman is hailed as a hero — until the captain's body is discovered.

programme.title: Forensic Files: For Love or Money
programme.desc: When a wealthy real estate tycoon goes missing, it appears to be foul play. In his will, he leaves instructions in case he should die under violent circumstances — which were carried out after a hiker comes across his bullet-ridden skull.

programme.title: Forensic Files: South of the Border
programme.desc: The murder of an American tourist in a Mexican resort draws law enforcement resources on both sides of the border. At first glance, the motive appears to be robbery, but careful analysis of the forensic evidence points to something more sinister.

programme.title: Forensic Files: The Stake-Out
programme.desc: Police are led on a wild goose chase when the wife of a prominent banker is kidnapped. An entomologist's unexpected discovery leads to a new suspect — and the realization that ordinary office equipment can leave extraordinary clues.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Walking Terror
programme.desc: A neighbor watched as a man stabbed his wife, pushed her into the swimming pool and held her head under water. The husband, however, had no recollection of the crime. A jury would have to decide between evidence and the mysteries of the mind.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Marked for Life
programme.desc: It would take 46 years, handwriting analysis and new fingerprint technology to solve the 1957 murders of two California police officers.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Plastic Puzzle
programme.desc: A man riding a bicycle was fatally injured in what police believed to be a hit-and-run accident. Tiny clues found at the scene created a picture of the vehicle which struck him and led police to its driver.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Up in Smoke
programme.desc: When an elderly couple died in a suspicious house fire, their son became the prime suspect. Investigators turned to forensic science to determine if the fire had been set deliberately, or if it was an unfortunate accident.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Soiled Plan
programme.desc: Police instituted an intense search when the mother of two young children went missing. Twenty years after her body was found, new technology recontextualized old evidence and pointed directly to the killer.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Headquarters
programme.desc: When hunters reported finding a skull in a Texas canyon, police immediately began an investigation. With a forensic artist's reconstruction, police eventually learned the victim's identity. Now all they had to do was find her killer.

programme.title: Forensic Files: One for the Road
programme.desc: A married couple decided to escape the cold of winter with a mini-vacation in Key West. The wife went missing and police searched every square inch of the island; they found nothing but a pair of sandals which might have belonged to her.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Army of Evidence
programme.desc: A mother of two young children was found dead in her bedroom. Her death was ruled a suicide — but when investigators learned she had almost died in a house fire three years earlier, they decided to take another look at the evidence.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Shear Luck
programme.desc: In 1991, when the wife of a serviceman was brutally murdered in the Philippines, investigators had to reassemble a tiny computer disk that had been cut to pieces in order to find the killer.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Tagging a Suspect
programme.desc: Bombings are difficult to solve because the perpetrator isn't usually at the scene and the evidence goes up in smoke. In this case, pieces of plastic the size of grains of sand hold the key to finding a murderer.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Strong Impressions
programme.desc: The wife of an Air Force officer was found dead in her bed with a plastic laundry bag near her face. Further investigation proved that the scene had been staged. Her death wasn't an accident — it was cold-blooded murder.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Cereal Killer
programme.desc: When a fire destroyed most of a home and a young boy went missing, police organized the largest search in the history of their small town. First the boy's backpack was discovered five miles from home, then his body was found 50 miles away.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Crash Course
programme.desc: A highway patrolman was dispatched to what he thought would be a routine traffic accident — until he looked in the car. He had seen hundreds of accidents, but none with as much blood as this.

programme.title: Forensic Files: A Leg Up On Crime
programme.desc: The decomposed body of a young woman was discovered in a Bakersfield irrigation canal. If there was trace evidence, it had been washed away.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Tight-Fitting Genes
programme.desc: A behavioral profile caused the Baton Rouge Police Department to search for the wrong man. The real perpetrator may have eluded arrest, had it not been for a molecular biologist who painted DNA picture of the suspect.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Deadly Valentine
programme.desc: An obstetrician returned home from the hospital and found his wife on the bathroom floor. She was covered with blood and not breathing. He tried unsuccessfully to revive her, staining his clothes with her blood in the process.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Picture This
programme.desc: A Modesto, California teenager goes missing. With no signs of struggle in her home, police suspect she has simply run away — until her naked, bruised body is discovered in a ditch 20 miles away.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Oily in the Morning
programme.desc: When police recovered the submerged car of a missing man, they expected to find his body — but it wasn't there. The investigation that followed would uncover an obsession turned deadly.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Gold Rush
programme.desc: Emergency dispatch received a call from a man who said his girlfriend shot and killed herself. The autopsy revealed that the gunshot wound was not self-inflicted, and the evidence on her body would give police a golden opportunity to catch her killer.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Four on the Floor
programme.desc: When a Native American woman is brutally killed in the desert of New Mexico, her killers leave a crime scene rich in forensic evidence: tire tracks, shoe impressions and even the murder weapons.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Writer's Block
programme.desc: A brilliant young architect falls ill and dies just before she is to testify in a criminal trial. The autopsy reveals she'd been poisoned with arsenic. Investigators must determine who had a motive for murder.

programme.title: Forensic Files: A Clean Getaway
programme.desc: When a dry cleaner employee is raped and murdered in her store, police turn to forensic science for the answers they need.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Prints Among Thieves
programme.desc: The murder of an eccentric millionaire was not entirely unexpected; he flaunted his wealth and cared little for personal security. The evidence at the crime seemed to indicate robbery, but investigators wondered if there was something more.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Unholy Alliance
programme.desc: When a young woman disappeared, police feared she was the latest victim in a string of similar crimes. A pair of bloody gloves, unique tire tracks and ordinary pine needles provided investigators with some extraordinary clues.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Cop Out
programme.desc: When a college student is found dead, evidence suggests that he knew his killer. With just three hairs and some microscopic cells, police unravel a web of lies and find the motive for murder.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Summer Obsession
programme.desc: In an affluent suburb of Philadelphia, police were called to the scene of what appeared to be an accidental drowning. The investigation gradually focused on one suspect who had more than a million reasons to want the victim dead.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Elemental Clue
programme.desc: When two women from the same town were murdered in the same way, police feared a serial killer was on the loose. At first they thought the victims had nothing in common until they found tiny clues linking them to the same man.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Moss, Not Grass
programme.desc: A young woman was found dead on a golf course in the Bahamas. The grass on that course was so distinctive, it had evidentiary value. The evidence led police to two suspects, each of whom blamed the other.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Material Witness
programme.desc: A teenager went missing after an evening of horseback riding. Her body was found a month later, three miles from her home. But the killer unknowingly left trace evidence behind.
